<?php
class ArrayReturnGet {
    public function __get($incoming): array {
        echo $incoming, ":";
        if ($incoming === "bad") { return 1; }
        return [1, "key" => 2];
    }
}
$receiver = new ArrayReturnGet;
echo $receiver->good === [1, "key" => 2] ? "ARRAY;" : "BAD;";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $receiver->bad === null; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(), ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class MixedArrayGet {
    public function __get(string $incoming): mixed {
        global $source;
        echo "GET;";
        return $source;
    }
}
$cell = 7;
$source = [1, &$cell];
$receiver = new MixedArrayGet;
echo $receiver->items === (function () use (&$source, &$cell) {
    $source[0] = 99;
    $cell = 8;
    return [1, 8];
})() ? "COPY_REF;" : "BAD;";
echo $source[0] === 99 ? "SOURCE;" : "BAD;";
echo $cell === 8 ? "ALIAS;" : "BAD;";

<?php
class ArrayPayload {
    public function __destruct() { echo "PAYLOAD;"; }
}
class RetiringArrayGet {
    public function __get(string $incoming): array {
        global $receiver;
        echo "GET;";
        $receiver = null;
        return [new ArrayPayload];
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
$receiver = new RetiringArrayGet;
$receiver->items;
echo "DONE;";
